sources.scope_note: Bounded audit of official open-data sources. No global survey is claimed.
sources.status_reason: The archive listing contains global albedo and thermal-inertia products, and the thermal-inertia readme describes thermal inertia. No mineral map is present.
sources.title: MGS TES special products and thermal-inertia maps

datasets.gap: The full lunar legend is not crosswalked; one code is not a taxonomy.
Codes are dataset-scoped; no global Mars legend and no other region.
Global 1:20M legend is not crosswalked and the GIS zip is not ingested.
Raw codes need the official GLiM legend; the 0.5 degree grid cannot resolve a local AOI.
Only four broad values; no aqueous alteration; 1:35M scale.
Heterogeneous regional maps; no shared crosswalk or global coverage.

requirements: Version the crosswalk independently of the source dataset.
Cite the official legend/description for every code.
Keep raw codes and original descriptions in every observation.
Never equate the same text code across bodies or datasets.
Do not infer aqueous alteration from iron oxide or a spectral index alone.
A crosswalk produces category_match/hard_filter only, never a similarity distance.
taxonomy_gaps.statement: Map units are dataset-scoped free text/codes. Only the bounded Moon and SIM 3464 pilots have a registry, and it covers the codes observed in those AOIs, not a global legend. No map unit may become a category filter before a versioned crosswalk with official legend citations is registered.
